faq.description: Everything you need to know before you buy — files, sizes, licence and delivery.
faq.note: Can't find what you're looking for? Send us a message — we reply within 2-3 business days.

items.question: What do I get after buying?
items.answer: Every pack includes the full wallpaper set, already sized for mobile and desktop — delivered as a single download, ready to use.

items.question: Which devices are supported?
items.answer: Every design works on iPhone, Android, and desktop. No cropping or resizing needed.

items.question: What resolution are the wallpapers?
items.answer: Every design is exported in HD/4K, so it stays sharp on any screen — from your phone to a widescreen monitor.

items.question: How do I get my wallpapers?
items.answer: The moment your payment is confirmed, your files are ready instantly — right there on the confirmation screen and in your account. You'll also get an email with the access link, in case you want to save it for later.

items.question: What if I lose the download email?
items.answer: No problem — you're not dependent on the email. Log into your account anytime: downloads stay available for good, with no limit on how many times you grab them.

items.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
items.answer: These wallpapers are for personal use only — resale or redistribution isn't allowed.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Since these are instant digital downloads, we can't offer refunds once the file has been delivered.
